dedupe_keys.name: aars simulation budgeted few shot adaptation of building energy surrogates in unseen climates

description: Özge Güneş Yavru and İsmail Burak Yavru publish AARS, a building-energy surrogate adapted to an unseen climate using one or three target simulations. The September 2026 archive covers 1,000 shared classroom designs, six source climates and eight held-out Turkish climates, with 14,000 EnergyPlus simulations. Python code is MIT-licensed and author-generated processed data are CC BY 4.0; both are freely available. Calibration designs are excluded from the stated test sets. The package can compare climate transfer and simulation-budget choices using frozen Ridge and gradient-boosting models, reference tables and reproduction scripts. Related catalogue record model-energyplus generates the source data. Recreating those simulations requires separately obtained Climate.OneBuilding EPW files, while analysis can use deposited outputs. Eight climates are the statistical units, not 8,000 independent locations. Version-sensitive refits and uncertainty estimates were not reproduced, and the associated manuscript is identified as a submission.
